answers:
To calculate the runtime of a 50Ah 12V battery powering a 60W fridge:

1. First, determine the usable capacity: LiFePO4 batteries are typically around 80-90% DoD (Depth of Discharge). For this calculation, we'll use 85%.
2. Capacity calculation: \( \text{Capacity} = \text{Ah} \times V = 50 \times 12 = 600 \text{ Wh} \)
3. Usable capacity: \( 600 \text{ Wh} \times 0.85 = 510 \text{ Wh} \)
4. Runtime calculation: \( \text{Runtime (hours)} = \frac{\text{Wh\_usable}}{\text{load\_watts}} = \frac{510 \text{ Wh}}{60 \text{ W}} = 8.5 \text{ hours} \)

The battery will run the fridge for approximately 8.5 hours.
